title: Robustness of Internal Signals for Hallucination Detection in Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.27041v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When given an image and a text prompt, vision-language models (VLMs) can produce seemingly sophisticated text responses. However, they are also prone to hallucinate objects in their output, which can have detrimental consequences in safety-critical applications. To detect these hallucinations, certain methods interestingly leverage internal signals from the VLM as it generates the text response; potentially, these methods use the same signals that led to a hallucination to detect it. We conduct an in-depth analysis to understand the robustness of these detection methods. First, we show that a naive baseline of a generated word's token position in the VLM text response achieves competitive performance. Further, we reveal how some detection methods rely on token position and use this heuristic as a shortcut. Second, we explore detection methods' sensitivity to language and vision modalities. translated_title: 视觉语言模型中用于幻觉检测的内部信号的鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 当给定一张图像和一个文本提示时，视觉语言模型（VLM）能够生成看似复杂的文本回复。然而，它们也容易在输出中产生物体幻觉，这在安全关键的应用中可能造成严重的负面后果。为了检测这些幻觉，一些方法巧妙地利用了VLM在生成文本回复时的内部信号；这些方法可能是使用导致幻觉产生的相同信号来检测幻觉。我们进行了深入分析以理解这些检测方法的鲁棒性。首先，我们表明，一个基于生成词在VLM文本回复中token位置的朴素基线即可达到有竞争力的性能。此外，我们揭示了一些检测方法如何依赖token位置并将这一启发式方法作为捷径。其次，我们探讨了检测方法对语言和视觉模态的敏感性。我们的实验表明，强大的检测方法……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本研究深入分析了基于VLM内部信号的幻觉检测方法的鲁棒性，揭示了许多检测方法实际上依赖token位置这一捷径，而一个朴素的token位置基线即可达到有竞争力的性能，并探讨了检测方法对语言和视觉模态的敏感性。
en_tdlr: This study provides an in-depth analysis of the robustness of VLM internal-signal-based hallucination detection methods, revealing that many detection methods rely on token position as a shortcut—while a naive token-position baseline already achieves competitive performance—and examines their sensitivity to language and vision modalities.
